title: Turn detector scores into a bounded operating policy
description: Move the detection threshold and human-review capacity. The same model produces different recall, precision, queue pressure, and error cost; a visual distribution shift challenges the chosen policy.

shift.label: Inject low-light and blur shift
shift.detail: Reduce recall and increase false alerts without changing the deployed model or threshold.

scenarios.label: Safety event review
scenarios.detail: Rare positives; missed events are costly and every alert receives human review.

scenarios.label: Retail inventory event
scenarios.detail: Events are more common and a false alert is cheap, so recall can take priority.

scenarios.label: Uploaded-media moderation
scenarios.detail: A larger review pool can absorb alerts, but severe misses still need a recall floor.
